inputs.goal:
Map E. coli sequencing reads from samples A, B, and C to the reference genome,
sort and index the resulting alignments, then call genomic variants across all
three samples jointly. The reference genome and reads are in the INPUT_DIR.
Write all outputs to WORK_DIR.

Map E. coli sequencing reads from samples A, B, and C to the reference genome,
sort and index the resulting alignments, then call genomic variants across all
three samples jointly. The reference genome and reads are in the INPUT_DIR.
Write all outputs to WORK_DIR.

work_dir_structure.input: WORK_DIR/input/  — staged input data (read-only, do not write here)
work_dir_structure.steps: WORK_DIR/steps/  — one subdirectory per executed step (NN_rulename/)
work_dir_structure.logs: WORK_DIR/logs/   — per-rule log files written automatically
work_dir_structure.snakefile: WORK_DIR/Snakefile — accumulating workflow, appended each step

path_conventions.input_files: Relative to WORK_DIR/input/. Example: 'samples/A.fastq' resolves to WORK_DIR/input/samples/A.fastq
path_conventions.output_files: Relative to this step's directory. Example: 'A.bam' resolves to WORK_DIR/steps/NN_rulename/A.bam
path_conventions.chained_inputs: To use a prior step's output as input, prefix with 'steps/NN_rulename/'. Example: 'steps/01_bwa_mem_A/A.bam'
path_conventions.never_use: Absolute paths, environment variable names, or bare filenames without the correct prefix.

outputs.name: bwa mem
outputs.description: Map reads using bwa mem, with optional sorting using samtools or picard.
outputs.example_rule:
rule bwa_mem:
    input:
        reads=["reads/{sample}.1.fastq", "reads/{sample}.2.fastq"],
        idx=multiext("genome", ".amb", ".ann", ".bwt", ".pac", ".sa"),
    output:
        "mapped/{sample}.bam",
    log:
        "logs/bwa_mem/{sample}.log",
    params:
        extra=r"-R '@RG\tID:{sample}\tSM:{sample}'",
        sorting="none",  # Can be 'none', 'samtools' or 'picard'.
        sort_order="queryname",  # Can be 'queryname' or 'coordinate'.
        sort_extra="",  # Extra args for samtools/picard.
    threads: 8
    wrapper:
        "master/bio/bwa/mem"

results.name: bcftools mpileup
results.description: Generate VCF or BCF containing genotype likelihoods for one or multiple alignment (BAM or CRAM) files.

outputs.name: bcftools mpileup
outputs.description: Generate VCF or BCF containing genotype likelihoods for one or multiple alignment (BAM or CRAM) files.
outputs.example_rule:
rule bcftools_mpileup:
    input:
        alignments=["mapped/{sample}.bam", "mapped/{sample}.bam"],
        ref="genome.fasta",  # this can be left out if --no-reference is in options
        index="genome.fasta.fai",
    output:
        pileup="pileups/{sample}.pileup.bcf",
    params:
        uncompressed_bcf=False,
        extra="--max-depth 100 --min-BQ 15",
    log:
        "logs/bcftools_mpileup/{sample}.log",
    wrapper:
        "master/bio/bcftools/mpileup"
